title: Complaint: RE Warren Jackson vs. Northwest Georgia Presbytery
disposition_detail: Case 2013-02 was found Administratively Out of Order; no merits ruling, reasoning, or relief is recorded in the available text.
first_summary: In Case 2013-02, a complaint by RE Warren Jackson against Northwest Georgia Presbytery, the 42nd General Assembly (2014) found the matter Administratively Out of Order. No separate merits opinion was published, so the record supplies no facts, allegations, reasoning, or relief. Companion Case 2013-05 was likewise found Administratively Out of Order, and Case 2013-09 was withdrawn as prematurely filed.
summary: The 42nd General Assembly (2014) found Case 2013-02, a complaint by RE Warren Jackson against Northwest Georgia Presbytery, Administratively Out of Order.
